note: X2F payment method profiles (spec 2.6). Each profile drives all copy about its method: what it is, where the money lands (this fills every "check your ..." prompt, so it never names the method itself), the typical arrival time and the seller's confirmation window, which is also the buyer's wait before a dispute (owner F9, 7 Nov: 90 min for instant types, 45 min for gift cards (owner G50), 24 h same or next day, 48 h to 4 days for slow types; per type from the approved F1 table) and the matching fields. Ids are catalog ids from data/payment-methods.json. payWindowMin is the buyer's time to pay from "secured" (owner p9-6; lead defaults pending the owner: 90 min for apps and instant transfers, 3 h for bank transfers, 24 h for cash by mail; 90 min for a gift card, whose code is sent like an app payment, while its 45-minute confirmWindowMin is the checker's, owner G50: LEAD DEFAULT pending owner p11-130), fixed on the trade at take. Launch set (spec 11.5, Plan 3 Task 3); the ten common types after Custom were added by owner 2026-11-07 F9 (F1 table; confirm windows per owner F9: instant 90 min, Faster Payments 3 h, same or next day 24 h, SWIFT 72 h); wording to be checked by the owner.

profiles.whatItIs: Zelle: a US bank-to-bank instant transfer built into most US banking apps.
profiles.landsIn: your bank account, checked in your bank's app
profiles.checkPrompt: Open your bank's app and check that the payment arrived in your account.

profiles.whatItIs: Cash App: a US payment app for sending money between people by $cashtag.
profiles.landsIn: your app balance, checked in the app's activity list
profiles.checkPrompt: Open the app's activity list and check that the payment is shown as received.

profiles.whatItIs: Revolut: a payments app with accounts in many currencies, used mostly in Europe.
profiles.landsIn: your app balance, checked in the app's transactions
profiles.checkPrompt: Open the app's transactions and check that the payment arrived in your balance.

profiles.whatItIs: Wise: an online money transfer service with balances in many currencies.
profiles.landsIn: your account balance, checked in the app or on the website
profiles.checkPrompt: Open the app or the website and check that the transfer is shown as received.

profiles.whatItIs: ACH: the standard US bank-to-bank transfer, usually settled in one to three business days.
profiles.landsIn: your bank account, checked in your bank's app or statement
profiles.checkPrompt: Check your bank's app or statement for the incoming transfer before you release.

profiles.whatItIs: SEPA: a euro bank transfer between banks in the Single Euro Payments Area, usually arriving the next business day.
profiles.landsIn: your bank account, checked in your bank's app or statement
profiles.checkPrompt: Check your bank's app or statement for the incoming transfer before you release.

profiles.whatItIs: Cash by mail: banknotes sent in a sealed envelope by post or courier.
profiles.landsIn: the envelope delivered to your mailing address, checked by counting it when it arrives
profiles.checkPrompt: Open the envelope, count the notes and check the amount before you release.

profiles.whatItIs: A payment method the two traders agree on in chat, for anything not yet in the list.
profiles.landsIn: wherever the two of you agreed, checked there yourself
profiles.checkPrompt: Check that the payment arrived the way you agreed before you release.

profiles.whatItIs: Interac e-Transfer: a Canadian bank transfer sent to an email address or phone number from most Canadian banking apps.
profiles.landsIn: your bank account, checked in your bank's app
profiles.checkPrompt: Open your bank's app and check that the transfer was deposited into your account.

profiles.whatItIs: SEPA Instant: a euro bank transfer between banks in the Single Euro Payments Area that arrives within seconds.
profiles.landsIn: your bank account, checked in your bank's app
profiles.checkPrompt: Open your bank's app and check that the payment arrived in your account.

profiles.whatItIs: PayPal: an online payment service for sending money to an email address or phone number.
profiles.landsIn: your account balance, checked in the app or on the website
profiles.checkPrompt: Open the app or the website and check that the payment is shown as completed in your balance.

fields.label: Email or phone number registered with the account

profiles.whatItIs: Venmo: a US payment app for sending money between people by username.
profiles.landsIn: your app balance, checked in the app's activity list
profiles.checkPrompt: Open the app's activity list and check that the payment is shown as received.

profiles.whatItIs: Pix: Brazil's instant payment system, run by the central bank and built into Brazilian banking apps.
profiles.landsIn: your bank account, checked in your bank's app
profiles.checkPrompt: Open your bank's app and check that the payment arrived in your account.

fields.label: Key (CPF or CNPJ, email, phone or random key)

profiles.whatItIs: UPI: India's instant payment system for sending money between bank accounts by a payment ID such as name@bank.
profiles.landsIn: your bank account, checked in your bank's app or payment app
profiles.checkPrompt: Open your bank's app or payment app and check that the payment arrived in your account.

profiles.whatItIs: Faster Payments: the UK bank-to-bank transfer, usually arriving within minutes and at most within two hours.
profiles.landsIn: your bank account, checked in your bank's app or statement
profiles.checkPrompt: Check your bank's app or statement for the incoming transfer before you release.

profiles.whatItIs: Domestic wire: a US bank-to-bank wire, usually arriving the same business day.
profiles.landsIn: your bank account, checked in your bank's app or statement
profiles.checkPrompt: Check your bank's app or statement for the incoming transfer before you release.

profiles.whatItIs: SWIFT: an international bank wire between countries, usually arriving in one to five business days.
profiles.landsIn: your bank account, checked in your bank's app or statement
profiles.checkPrompt: Check your bank's app or statement for the incoming transfer before you release.

profiles.whatItIs: A gift card: a prepaid card for a shop or service, paid by sending its code.
profiles.landsIn: the card's code, checked on the issuer's website or app
profiles.checkPrompt: Check the card's balance on the issuer's website or app, or redeem it, before you release.

fields.label: Card brand and country you accept
